_about: Where the demo brand's made-up product lives and how to film it, for the capture tool (tools/capture/README.md). The product is library/fixtures/demo-product, served on this Mac only: node library/fixtures/demo-product/serve.mjs (port 4317). It exists so the style library's capture-family previews never need a client's product. Keys that start with _ are notes for people.
demo_account: Acme workspace (made up; the demo product has no accounts)
signs_in: Nobody: the demo product has no sign-in.
_browser: The studio's own window: no sign-in is needed, and nothing of anyone's own Chrome is involved.

never_show.what: Billing pages (the demo product has none)

clock.note: The greeting and the date on the Overview come from the page's own clock, so the demo time sets them.
